title: Get Started — Zumungo
excerpt: Install Zumungo in about 15 minutes. Two paths: a pre-flashed Raspberry Pi image, or a universal one-command installer for any Linux box. Then a browser wizard walks you through AI, devices, and rooms.
content_html:
Open Zumungo in your browser

Once the installer finishes, point your browser at:

https://zumungo.local

Zumungo advertises itself on your LAN via mDNS, so zumungo.local resolves on Mac, Windows, iPhone, iPad, and Android out of the box. On older Linux you may need to install Avahi (sudo apt install avahi-daemon).

Browser security warning? Yes — Zumungo uses a self-signed HTTPS certificate by default because the domain is on your private network. Click "Advanced → Proceed anyway". On first visit, Zumungo will offer to install a trusted certificate, or you can wire up Cloudflare Tunnel for a real domain with a valid cert (see Support).
